forecast_rule: FORECAST per-cell budget = measured E4 cost x 2 (labeled FORECAST). p2 uses measured costs as forecast only (campaign hard rule 6); the measured E4 supersedes the provisional reference-based $0.30 candidate forecast.

FORECAST.note: per_arm_budget_usd = per_cell_cost_usd x 6 cells (3 repetitions x 2 models). grid_total_usd = per_cell_cost_usd x 24. All four arms are forecast at the same x2 envelope because only the continue arm was measured in p1; fork_* and escalate cells are re-measured in p2 and the forecast is replaced by their own measured values as they land.

arms.note: p1 measured only the continue arm; forecast envelope carried over from E4 x2 until the first fork_blind cell measures.
